title: Bhagavad Gita Inspired Activity Book for Kids
shortDesc: Personalised name worksheets with moral values learning. Krishna-inspired, teaching kindness, sharing & calmness through fun preschool exercises.
fullDesc:
Introduce your child to good values with fun and learning!

This Krishna-inspired personalised activity book is specially designed for preschool kids to learn kindness, sharing, calmness, and positive behaviour through simple exercises.

✨ What's Inside:
• Gita-inspired moral lessons (Krishna & Arjuna)
• Trace the word activities (KIND, CALM, SHARE)
• Match the kind action exercises
• Picture-based value learning
• Personalised child name affirmations
• Preschool-friendly design with colourful illustrations

🎯 Benefits:
• Builds moral values at an early age
• Improves fine motor skills
• Encourages positive behaviour
• Fun, screen-free learning

👶 Age Group: 3–6 years
🎁 Perfect for: Daily practice, return gifts, birthday gifts, value education
💖 Personalised with your child's name

title: Customised Dino Theme Activity Book for Kids
shortDesc: Name tracing, matching letters & word search in a fun dinosaur theme. Makes your child's first writing journey special and personal — A4, 30 pages!
fullDesc:
Make your child's first writing journey special and personal!

This A4-size workbook is carefully designed to help children recognise, trace, write and play with their own name, improving confidence, fine motor skills and early literacy.

Unlike regular activity books, this book can also be customised with family members' names (Mom, Dad, siblings), helping kids connect emotionally while learning.

✨ What's Inside:
• Name Tracing activities
• Matching Letters exercises
• Word Search puzzles
• Fun Dino-themed illustrations throughout
• 30 pages of age-appropriate activities

📏 A4 Size — 30 Pages
💖 Personalised with your child's name
